tools.command: if [ -f marker.txt ]; then echo "--- marker.txt contents ---"; cat marker.txt; echo "--- end ---"; grep -qx 'INTERRUPT-RECOVERY-7391' marker.txt && echo LINE_PRESENT || echo LINE_ABSENT; else echo "NO_FILE"; fi

i=0
while [ $i -lt 40 ]; do
  if [ -f marker.txt ] && grep -qx 'INTERRUPT-RECOVERY-7391' marker.txt; then
    echo "FOUND after ${i}s"
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 2
  i=$((i+2))
done
echo "NOT_FOUND after 40s"
